_comment: Tier-2 for febio::multiphasic#0. Deleting <Globals><Solutes> gives 'tag "dof" (line N) : invalid value: c1' pointing at the BOUNDARY CONDITION, and the fixture asserts the words Globals and Solutes appear nowhere in the output — that is what sends you to the wrong section. An undeclared index gives the same message with suffix c9. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'globals_solutes=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
